test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 26 Aug 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: If a sum of ₹9,375 is invested at 8% annual compound interest rate calculated on a half-yearly compounded basis, find the amount received after one year.
solution:
**Given:**

Principal (P) = ₹9,375

Rate (r) = 8% per annum

Time (t) = 1 year

Compounding frequency = Half-yearly

**Formula used:**

A = P(1+(r/n)/(100))ⁿt

Where,

n = number of compounding periods per year

t = time in years

**Calculations:**

A = 9375(1+(8/2)/(100))² times ¹

⇒ A = 9375(1+(4)/(100))²

⇒ A = 9375(1+0.04)²

⇒ A = 9375(1.04)²

⇒ A = 9375 × 1.0816

⇒ A = 10140

**∴ The correct answer is option (1).**

17
